proposal.falsifier_or_acceptance_gate: Reject every preregistered mutation and emit only the declared bounded software, symbolic, formal, numerical, or structural completion.
proposal.hypothesis: A bounded TLS 1.3 structural refusal artifact can expose declared obligations while refusing unsupported scientific, operational, identity, or authority promotion.
proposal.novelty_against_880_frozen_proposals: Prior TLS work does not freeze the July 2026 RFC 9846 replacement status with record, transcript, key-share, extension, state, alert, and bounded refusal obligations.
proposal.null_or_failure_condition: The artifact omits a declared TLS 1.3 structural refusal obligation, accepts a preregistered mutation, erases a negative, or promotes a result beyond its evidence lane.
proposal.rollback_or_recovery: Stop the proposal, retain every failed witness, rewrite no history, and leave external, sibling, participant, production, and authority state unchanged.
proposal.title: TLS 1.3 RFC 9846 record, handshake, transcript, version, cipher, key-share, extension, state, alert, resource-budget, and refusal tribunal
